Title: Azure Cosmos DB Apache Cassandra API

Body.Content:
We're excited to announce the preview of the Apache Cassandra API on Azure Cosmos DB. The Cassandra API in Azure Cosmos DB will allow developers who are familiar with Cassandra and using its SDKs and tools to lift-and-shift existing applications. It will also enable you to build new applications using Cassandra API against a globally distributed, multimodel database service designed to scale throughput and storage across any number of geographical regions with comprehensive SLAs. 

Sign up to access the Cassandra API today.
